skill.summary: Use semantic vector search to locate relevant files in a codebase.

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code, tool scripts, or instructions to access secrets. The two static network findings are documentation URLs in SKILL.md, not runtime network calls or exfiltration behavior.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL appears in SKILL.md frontmatter as source metadata for the upstream repository. It does not instruct the assistant to make a network request or send user data.
The URL is a documentation link to the source repository for more information. It is not executable code and does not create a network or data-exfiltration path.

content.user_title: Find Relevant Files with Semantic Search
content.value_statement: Large repositories make it difficult to find files by meaning instead of exact names. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that use Vexor for vector-powered semantic file search.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Vexor for semantic file search in a repository.
Guides AI coding assistants toward meaning-based file discovery workflows.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as declared compatible tools.
Points users to the upstream Vexor source repository for more details.
Provides prompt-only guidance without bundled executable code.
limitations: The skill file does not include Vexor installation commands or command examples.
Search quality depends on the external Vexor CLI and its indexed repository data.
It does not perform file search by itself without the referenced CLI workflow.
It provides general guidance, not project-specific indexing rules.

use_cases.title: Explore an unfamiliar repository
use_cases.description: Use semantic search guidance to identify files related to a feature or bug before editing.

use_cases.title: Support AI coding sessions
use_cases.description: Help an assistant find relevant files by concept when exact filenames are unknown.

use_cases.title: Speed up maintenance research
use_cases.description: Find likely implementation areas for refactors, incidents, or technical debt reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Find files by concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Vexor skill to help me find files related to this concept: [describe feature, bug, or behavior].

prompt_templates.title: Locate likely implementation areas
prompt_templates.prompt: Use semantic file search guidance to identify where [feature or workflow] is probably implemented in this repository.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an edit plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Vexor-style semantic search to find relevant files for changing [behavior], then propose an edit plan with risks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare related code paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Use semantic search to find files related to [domain], group the likely code paths, and explain which files should be inspected first.

output_examples.input: Find files related to user authentication flows.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of likely authentication files, grouped by login flow, session handling, and authorization checks.

output_examples.input: Identify where billing retry behavior may be implemented.
output_examples.output: A concise investigation path with candidate files, why each file is relevant, and what to inspect next.

output_examples.input: Prepare for a refactor of search result ranking.
output_examples.output: A short map of related ranking, indexing, and query handling files with suggested review order.

best_practices: Describe the behavior or concept clearly before asking for semantic file search.
Verify candidate files manually before making edits.
Use semantic search results to narrow investigation, then inspect exact code references.
anti_patterns: Do not treat semantic matches as proof that a file owns the behavior.
Do not skip tests or code inspection after finding likely files.
Do not share private repository data with external services without approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It guides semantic file search workflows for finding relevant files in a codebase.

faq.question: Does the skill include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill file contains prompt-only guidance and repository links.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it install Vexor automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill does not include installation automation or command scripts.

faq.question: Can it search files without an indexed repository?
faq.answer: No. Semantic search depends on the referenced Vexor workflow and available index data.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private code?
faq.answer: Review your data handling policy before using any external CLI or service with private repositories.
